alerts.title: Chestnut Hill East Station Parking Lot Update
alerts.text: Only 18 parking spots (including 1 ADA spot) are designated for customers on East Chestnut Hill Ave., alongside the South lot. Additionally, no overnight parking is allowed at Chestnut Hill East Station until construction is completed.

alerts.title: Outbound Platform Boarding, Train #207, Norristown Transit Center
alerts.text: Every weekday until further notice, passengers must board inbound Train #207 departing at 5:50 am on the outbound platform at Norristown Transit Center.

alerts.title: Shuttle Busing Between Norristown Transit Center and Bridgeport Station
alerts.text: Bus service replaces train service from Norristown Transit Center to Bridgeport Station through December 19. Passengers should allow an additional 15 minutes for travel. For details and schedules, visit SEPTA.org. Shuttle bus information is available on a separate Shuttle Bus schedule page.

alerts.title: 11th St Station Closed
alerts.text: 11th St and the 11th St concourse is closed to fast-track elevator construction and renovations. Please use 13th St during construction. For more information, visit SEPTA.org.

alerts.title: 8th-Market Station Elevator to Eastbound Platform Out of Service
alerts.text: The elevator at 8th-Market Station to the eastbound platform is out of service until mid-December. For accessible eastbound travel, please use 5th St/Independence Hall Station.

alerts.title: Notice of Bus Stop Change
alerts.text: The eastbound stop at Washington Ave & Moyamensing Ave is closed. Use nearby stop at Washington Ave & 3rd St.

alerts.title: Notice of Bus Stop Changes
alerts.text: Stops at Front & Ellsworth, Washington & 4th and Moyamensing & 2nd are closed. Use nearby stops at Washington Ave & Front, 3rd or 5th.

alerts.title: Potential Delays due to Amtrak Infrastructure Project
alerts.text: Due to an Amtrak infrastructure project near William H. Gray III 30th St Station: Paoli/Thorndale, Cynwyd, Trenton, Chestnut Hill West, Fox Chase and West Trenton trains may experience delays of up to 10 minutes through November 21. Please plan for added travel time. SEPTA apologizes for the inconvenience.

alerts.title: Monthly Saturday Shuttle Busing 69th St Transit Center to Media/Sharon Hill
alerts.text: To conduct overhead wire inspections and maintenance, shuttle buses replace trolley service on the first Saturday of each month until further notice. Riders should allow an additional 15 minutes for travel. For details and schedules, visit SEPTA.org. Shuttle bus information is available on a separate D1 bus & D2 bus schedule pages.

alerts.title: Sunday Schedule in Effect for Thanksgiving Day
alerts.text: Bus, Metro and Regional Rail routes operate on a Sunday schedule on Thanksgiving Day. Routes that do not have Sunday schedules do not operate. All modes resume regular weekday schedule at the start of service day, Friday, November 27.

alerts.title: Modified Bus Schedules: Thanksgiving to President’s Day
alerts.text: Due to adjusted school schedules between Thanksgiving and President’s Day, select bus routes operate on modified schedules between November 2026 and February 2027.

alerts.title: Southbound Faregate Entrance Closed
alerts.text: The southbound faregate entrance at Broad-Girard Station is closed until further notice. Passengers may access the platform through the faregates on the northbound side.

alerts.title: Southwest Entrance Closed
alerts.text: The southwest entrance at Drexel Station at 30th Street is closed until further notice due to a water main break. Other entrances remain available for passenger use.

alerts.title: Weekday, Mid-day Shuttle Busing Fox Chase to Wayne Junction Stations
alerts.text: Due to scheduled track work, buses replace trains on weekdays only from approximately 9 am - 2:30 pm in both directions between Fox Chase and Wayne Junction stations beginning Dec. 7 until April 2027. Passengers should allow an additional 30 minutes for travel. For details and schedules, visit septa.org. Shuttle bus information is available on a separate Fox Chase Shuttle Bus schedule page.

alerts.title: Outbound Platform Boarding from Secane to 49th St Stations
alerts.text: On Saturday, November 21, from 6 am to 6 pm, passengers must board on the outbound platforms from Secane to 49th St stations.

alerts.title: Outbound Platform Boarding from Neshaminy Falls to Noble Stations
alerts.text: From Saturday, November 21 through Sunday, November 22, passengers must board on the outbound platforms from Neshaminy Falls to Noble stations.

alerts.title: Shuttle Busing Between 40th Street Portal and Yeadon Loop
alerts.text: Bus service replaces trolley service from the 40th Street Portal to the Yeadon Loop on Saturday, November 21 and Sunday, November 22.

alerts.title: Southbound Platform Boarding Snyder and Oregon Stations
alerts.text: On Thursday, November 19 and Friday, November 20, from 10 pm until the end of service daily, passengers must board on the southbound platforms at Snyder and Oregon stations.

alerts.title: Weekly Sunday & Monday Trolley Tunnel Diversion
alerts.text: Service is re-routed to 40th St and Market St on Sunday and Monday nights beginning at 10 pm until 5 am the next morning due to scheduled maintenance. Use the [L] for continued service to/from Center City.

alerts.title: Shuttle Busing Between Elmwood & Island Aves to the Eastwick Loop
alerts.text: Bus service replaces trolley service from Elmwood & Island Aves to the Eastwick Loop on Tuesday, November 24.

alerts.title: Shuttle Busing Between the 40th St Portal and 61st-Baltimore
alerts.text: Bus service replaces trolley service from the 40th St Portal to 61st-Baltimore through Tuesday, November 24 due to a broken sewer line. Normal trolley service resumes at the beginning of service on Wednesday, November 25.

alerts.title: Heads up: it’s marathon weekend. As a result, many buses will be on detour Saturday and Sunday.

alerts.title: Paoli/Thorndale Schedule Changes Effective November 22, 2026
alerts.text: Amtrak has completed their infrastructure project. As a result, this new schedule reflects weekday and weekend service changes, including inbound trains operating 5 minutes later to Gray 30th St Station. Refer to this PDF schedule for details, as times may not change at all stations on adjusted trains.

alerts.title: Eastbound Platform Boarding Baltimore Ave to Drexel Hill Junction Stations
alerts.text: From Monday, November 23 through Wednesday, November 25, from 9:30 am to 3 pm daily, passengers must board on the eastbound platforms from Baltimore Avenue to Drexel Hill Junction stations.

alerts.title: Northbound Platform Boarding Township Line Rd to Beechwood-Brookline Stations
alerts.text: From Monday, November 23 through Wednesday, November 25, from 9:30 am to 3 pm daily, passengers must board on the northbound platforms from Township Line Road to Beechwood-Brookline stations.
